response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong full-stack engineering expertise and recent exposure to AI infrastructure work, the role requires director-level strategic technical leadership and customer advisory experience. His background emphasizes hands-on implementation across diverse technologies rather than strategic product vision, customer consulting, or demonstrated AI platform expertise. His AI experience is very recent (April 2025) and infrastructure-focused rather than strategic.
strengths: Extensive full-stack engineering background spanning 20 years across web, mobile, cloud, and infrastructure domains
Solid cloud infrastructure expertise with AWS CDK, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices demonstrated across multiple roles
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and knowledge sharing through open-source contributions and technical talks
concerns: AI/ML expertise is very recent (April 2025) and focused on infrastructure implementation rather than strategic product vision or recognized platform impact
No demonstrated director-level strategic advisory or customer consulting experience, which are key responsibilities of this role
Missing preferred advanced degree in AI-related field and limited evidence of identifying future state cloud product opportunities
